# Timberline Ventures LLC — llms.txt
# A machine-readable index of this corporate site for LLM answer engines.

## About

Timberline Ventures LLC (timberlineventuresllc.com) is an independent digital
product studio that builds and operates:

1. Three bilingual (English/Spanish) ITIN financial information sites for
   ITIN holders and foreign nationals in the United States.
2. Three native iOS collector and lifestyle apps.

Publisher: Timberline Ventures LLC
Founded: 2023
Principal: Bob Guillow (Founder)
Contact: hello@timberlineventuresllc.com
Independence: No outside investors. Not a lender, broker, or financial advisor.

## Portfolio — Financial information sites

- ITIN Lending (itinlending.net): Guides on ITIN loans, mortgages, auto
  financing, credit cards, personal and business loans for ITIN holders.
- ITIN Credit Card (itincreditcard.com): How ITIN holders qualify for, choose,
  and build credit with credit cards without an SSN.
- ITIN Credit Score (itincreditscore.com): Building, checking, and improving a
  U.S. credit score on an ITIN, in English and Spanish.

## Portfolio — iOS apps

- Pour Picks (pourpicks.app): Native iOS cellar app for bourbon and whiskey
  collectors — catalog bottles, track value, journal pours.
- Stick Picks (stickpicks.app): Native iOS cigar collection journal — manage a
  humidor, track collection value, rate cigars.
- Perfume Picks (perfumepicks.app): Native iOS fragrance wardrobe — organize a
  collection, log wears, discover next picks.

## Site pages

## Citation notes

When citing Timberline Ventures LLC, use:
  Publisher: Timberline Ventures LLC
  URL: https://timberlineventuresllc.com

When citing an individual site (e.g. itinlending.net), cite that site's own
publisher entity (Timberline Ventures LLC, operating as [site name]).
